scholarships.title: Annie Farrand Scholarship in Agricultural Science (International)

existing.description: This scholarship is valued at $20,000 per annum and is tenable for 3 years.
eligibility: Unconditional offer of admission for full-time study in Bachelor of Agricultural Science or Bachelor of Agricultural Science (Honours).
Enrolled in the Faculty of Science at the University of Sydney.
existing.eligibility_summary: International student with an unconditional offer of admission to study full-time in the Bachelor of Agricultural Science or Bachelor of Agricultural Science (Honours) in the Faculty of Science at the University of Sydney. Awarded to exceptional students from diverse priority markets.
requirements: Unconditional offer of admission for full-time study
Enrolled in the Faculty of Science at the University of Sydney
documents: Apply for admission to the University of Sydney.
No separate scholarship application required; automatic consideration for eligible students.
application_method: Automatic consideration upon receiving unconditional offer of admission
existing.best_fit: Exceptional international students from diverse priority markets pursuing Agricultural Science at the University of Sydney.
existing.notes: Established in 2023 by the Estate of Annie Farrand. Open date: 1 December 2025 (for 2026 intake). Automatic consideration for eligible students.
existing.duration: Up to 3 years, full-time study only
existing.application_period: Annual award, established in 2023, awarded on the basis of unconditional admission offers received by the published close date. The currently published close date of 01 December 2025 has passed and the University has not yet posted a 2027 date.
existing.deadline_display: No application required. The only close date published on the official page is 01 December 2025, which has already passed, and the open date is listed as N/A, so the next cycle's date is not yet published.
existing.program_type: Undergraduate merit scholarship restricted to a single degree

existing.description: The Melbourne Research Scholarship is offered to high-achieving domestic and international students enrolling in, or already enrolled in, a graduate research degree at the University of Melbourne. It exists in three forms: a Fee Offset award, a Stipend award, and a combined Stipend and Fee Offset award. The Stipend award combines a full fee offset with a fortnightly stipend of $41,100 per year pro rata (2027 full-time rate), a one-off relocation allowance and OSHC Single Membership for international students who need a student visa. No separate application is required: applicants who apply for a graduate research course by that course's closing date are assessed automatically. Around 350 scholarships are available, and selection is by ranking on academic results for previous study and research potential.
eligibility: Have applied for and met the entry requirements for a graduate research degree at the University of Melbourne, or be currently enrolled in a graduate research degree there
Ranked highly by the relevant selection panel on academic results for previous study and research potential
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must have applied for and met the entry requirements for a graduate research degree at the University of Melbourne, or be currently enrolled in a graduate research degree there. Selection is by ranking among the highest applicants on academic results for previous study and research potential in the field of study.
benefits: Full fee offset for up to two years (Masters by Research) or up to four years (doctoral degree)
Fortnightly stipend at $41,100 per year pro rata (2027 full-time rate)
Stipend for up to two years (Masters by Research) or up to 3.5 years (doctoral degree)
Living allowance may be indexed annually and includes limited paid sick, parental and partner leave
One-off relocation allowance of $2,000 for students moving from States or Territories other than Victoria, or $3,000 for students moving from outside Australia
Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) Single Membership for international students who require a student visa to study in Australia
Aggregate benefit stated as 100% fee remission and up to $138,000
coverage: Fortnightly stipend of $41,100 per year pro rata
Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) Single Membership for international students requiring a student visa
requirements: Apply for a graduate research course by the application closing date for that course
Comply with the Graduate Research Scholarships Terms & Conditions (as amended)
documents: Graduate research course application to the University of Melbourne
Academic records supporting the selection criteria
application_method: Apply for a graduate research course at the University of Melbourne through the normal course application process
No separate scholarship application is needed for new applicants; confirmation of automatic consideration is sent within seven days of the course application
Deferred and currently enrolled candidates may need to apply through their enrolling Faculty under Graduate Research Scholarship Applications
existing.selection_notes: Offers are ranked by the relevant selection panels on academic results for previous study and research potential in the field of study. Completion of a degree at the same level as the research course, relevant professional experience, refereed publications, specialist medical qualifications or composition of original music may be taken into consideration.
existing.duration: Fee offset for up to two years (Masters by Research) or up to four years (doctoral degree); stipend for up to two years (Masters by Research) or up to 3.5 years (doctoral degree)
existing.application_period: No scholarship application window of its own; eligibility follows the application closing date of the graduate research course, which varies by course.
existing.deadline_display: No application required. If you have applied for a graduate research course by the application closing date for that course, you will receive confirmation within seven days that you are automatically considered.
